mission.title: Coroner's Report
mission.description: Destroy a band of imposter Agents and tag their bodies with tracer programs.

npc.say: What, you forgot already? Okay: once you have the right body, just "give" it the tracer. It really isn't all that hard to remember, operative.
These imposter Agents are obviously being directed by a powerful new player in the City. But who that could be, I can't even conjecture.
We will bring your system crashing down around you.
Whew. I thought I was a goner!

phase.briefing: Neutralizing these imposter programs has become a priority. In order to do this, we need to know more about them. You will locate a band of these imposters, destroy them, and tag their bodies with our special tracer program for recovery and analysis.

enter.say: You'll find the operative Tomita here. She'll provide you with the tracer programs you'll use to "tag" the bodies of the dead imposter programs.

talk.say: Oh, you're Gray's operative. Well, pay attention: once you have the right body, just "give" it the tracer. That's all there is to it.

objective.text: Get the tracer programs from Tomita

done.say: Take these tracer programs: you'll need them to tag the bodies for recovery.
Leave the area and I'll guide you to your targets.

phase.briefing: I am updating your waypoint with the location of the imposters. Proceed there with all due haste.

enter.say: The imposter squad is inside that building. Remember, you have to "give" a tracer to each of the four imposters once you've terminated them.
Exiles? What are they doing there?

done.say: Don't forget to plant a tracer program on his body.
Hm, a bystander. You needn't bother about them.

complete.say: You've disabled all of the imposter programs in the area. Now give each of the bodies a tracer program.
Good, I'm receiving tracer signals from all four bodies. You can leave the area now.

mission.finish: That was efficient work, {player}... Many humans would have been distracted by those bystanders. The retrieval of those bodies should greatly facilitate our knowledge of these renegade imposter programs.
